insight.title: Why the best paths are never straight
insight.subtitle: The quiet art of choosing one direction over many.

sections.text: We often imagine success as a loud, crowded race toward everything at once. We want to be everywhere, serving everyone, capturing every fleeting spark. Yet, the world’s most enduring names do something far more difficult. They choose a single, quiet path and leave the rest of the wild forest behind.

Strategy is simply the art of saying no. It is the steady hand that prunes the branches so the tree can touch the sky. By narrowing their focus, a business stops drifting and starts moving with intent. They solve one human problem so deeply that they become the only meaningful answer.

This clarity changes how we live. When a company knows its soul, every product feels like a promise kept. We feel the care in a well-made tool or a seamless service. In a world of endless noise, the most powerful strategy is a simple, honest devotion to doing one thing well.

news.title: Climate change is making days longer, new research shows
news.description: In what researchers see as confirmation that climate change is changing the length of the day on our planet, a new study has shown that Earth's rotation has slowed in recent decades - more than at almost any other time in millions of years.
